project: MINERVA QCELL P&ID - Colour-Line-First Engineering Process Model
owner: Mott MacDonald / SCK CEN - MYRRHA-MINERVA Phase 1
description: Wave roadmap for decomposing the real QCELL/RFCELL P&ID SVGs into colour-defined process lines, preserving sequence and scope boundaries.

waves.name: Source Ingestion & Style Extraction
waves.expected_output: data/svg/*.svg copied from real sources; element/colour/style extraction with correct inline-style precedence

waves.name: Layer / Mechanical-Section Engine
waves.expected_output: Per-section (QM / Jumper / QVB / QINFRA) layer assignment for every colour line

waves.name: Geometry, Arrow Tracing & Sequential Ordering
waves.expected_output: arrows_detected + sequential_components per line (currently DEFERRED_W004 placeholders)

waves.name: Tag & Instrument Register Reconciliation (XLSX coverage delta)
waves.expected_output: Reconcile the 297 auto-catalogued components against the official tag/instrument register (XLSX); report coverage delta (matched / false-positive / missing) + nomenclature reconciliation; cross-validate colour-derived line identity against ISA tag class (configs/isa_classes.json)
waves.note: Swapped to first position per engineering review — this is the question a reviewer asks first. Interactive viewer moved to W006. [W005 delivered: 0 exact-tag overlap is a real finding — design & as-drawn schemes orthogonal; coverage reported per TYPE. See reports/W005_XLSX_RECONCILIATION_REPORT.md]

waves.name: Design<->As-Drawn Cross-Map + Interactive Viewer
waves.expected_output: Confidence-scored bidirectional design<->as-drawn tag cross-map (build_w006_crossmap.py -> data/crossmap/*.json, reports/W006_*); interactive layered viewer with layer toggling, pan/zoom, tag search, click-through metadata (build_viewer.py -> publish/interactive_viewer.html)
waves.note: Option A DELIVERED: cross-map engine turns W005's 0%-exact-overlap finding into a functional confidence-scored map - 97 design / 141 as-drawn real; 43 mapped (0 HIGH / 39 MEDIUM@0.75 / 4 LOW@0.45); 54 unmapped. Honesty enforced: HIGH requires an independent corroborator (SIGNAL_MATCH or KNOWN_SEED), KNOWN_SEEDS empty by design. Option B SCAFFOLDED: interactive_viewer.html skeleton (layer toggles, pan/zoom, tag search, metadata popup) - full plan in docs/W006_INTERACTIVE_UI_PLAN.md. 13 W006 tests green.

waves.name: CI Workflow + Cross-Drawing / Temperature Annotation
waves.expected_output: CI (GitHub Actions) running ./make.sh + tests on push; cross-drawing QCELL<->RFCELL identity reconciliation; 4.5 K / 2 K / warm classification per segment
waves.note: Plan documented in docs/W007_CICD_PLAN.md. Workflow file staged as ci/minerva-pid-test.yml (cannot push .github/workflows/ - GitHub App lacks 'workflows' permission); W007 must land it. Matrix Py3.10-3.12, libcairo2, standalone test runners, golden-file gate tolerant of known XLSX byte jitter.

waves.name: Interactive Viewer Enhancement
waves.expected_output: Production-ready single-file interactive design<->as-drawn cross-map viewer (build_viewer.py -> publish/interactive_viewer.html) completing W006 Option B: bidirectional tag<->SVG highlighting, confidence-based triage workflow, per-layer show/hide + export, side-by-side QCELL/RFCELL comparison, design<->as-drawn toggle, search, 21-layer tree, zoom/pan, deep-link URL state.
waves.note: Completes the W006 Interactive UI Plan (docs/W006_INTERACTIVE_UI_PLAN.md). All five core features delivered as a self-contained HTML file (no build step). 97 design / 141 as-drawn rows; 43 mapped (0 HIGH / 39 MEDIUM / 4 LOW); 54 unmapped. 141 hit-testable SVG markers (139 QCELL / 2 RFCELL) injected from catalog x/y in the shared viewBox. Triage decisions persist in localStorage and export as triage_decisions.json for KNOWN_SEEDS feedback (heuristic map stays read-only). 6 viewer tests green (tests/test_w008_viewer.py); report in reports/W008_VIEWER_REPORT.md. NOTE: this slot was originally the deferred 'Round-Trip Reassembly' wave; repurposed per the W008 handover to finish the interactive viewer.

waves.name: Final Deliverables & Commissioning
waves.expected_output: Commissioned v1.0 canonical register (data/excel/canonical_register_release_v1.0.yaml) + engineering sign-off record (reports/W009_SIGNOFF_RECORD.{json,md}) + commissioning report (reports/W009_COMMISSIONING_REPORT.md). Triage feedback loop: viewer triage_decisions.json -> ingest_triage -> configs/known_seeds.json (KNOWN_SEEDS) -> HIGH-tier promotion on next build_w006_crossmap.
waves.note: Commissioning infrastructure delivered. ingest_triage.py promotes reviewer-CONFIRMED viewer decisions into configs/known_seeds.json (TYPE-gated + register-existence validated; reject/defer recorded for audit). build_w009_release.py consolidates W005 reconciliation + W006 cross-map + seeds into a commissioned v1.0 register with per-tag status (commissioned=HIGH/confirmed | provisional=MEDIUM/LOW | open=unmapped) plus a sign-off sheet. Honesty preserved: committed known_seeds.json is EMPTY, so the honest baseline is 0 commissioned / 43 provisional / 54 open until a reviewer signs off. W009 stats registered in ci/golden_gate.py. 13 W009 tests green (tests/test_w009_commissioning.py). Remaining for sign-off: reviewer triages the 43 provisional + 54 open tags in the viewer, ingests decisions, completes the sign-off record.

current_wave_note: W009 commissioning infrastructure landed; awaiting engineering reviewer triage + sign-off to populate KNOWN_SEEDS and commission tags.
